name: Montgolfier human balloon flight
description: A hot-air balloon built by the Montgolfier brothers carried two people on a free flight over Paris in 1783.

impact.note: First human free flight, a new ability touching few lives; hot-air craft were soon displaced by separately developed gas balloons.

events.statement: Jean-François Pilâtre de Rozier and the Marquis d’Arlandes travelled in a Montgolfier hot-air balloon in France.
events.caveats: Earlier uncrewed and tethered ascents preceded this episode; exact flight route and duration are not stated here.
